lines: d37: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Skylar Maier is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d37: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d37: 🕯️ Skylar is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d37: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d37: 🕯️ Skylar Maier is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d37: What Skylar kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d37: "Skylar's gone." Angelo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Skylar." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d37: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Chester blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d37: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.

d37: 📖 LEARNED: Draw Fire (Level 1). In the wilds, beside your people, you make yourself the problem. Shout, wave, bleed loudly — the beast's eye stays on you and off them. Monsters focus you instead of your allies.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d37: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d37: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Skylar Maier, 37 days. The mantle passes to Chester Winter.
d37: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Chester Winter, 30 — an army medic. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, War Cry, Dowsing, Battlefield Grace, Green Thumb, Literally, Berserker Rage.
d37: The village's quarrel was with Skylar — and Skylar is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d37: At the grave, Angelo, Meihua, Arthur and 2 more speak for Chester — "Skylar trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d37: The fire knew Chester before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d105: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d105: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d105: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.

d105: 📖 LEARNED: Tracking People (Level 1). People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.
d105: 📖 LEARNED: Night Hunting (Level 1). Hunting at night is not hunting blind. It is hunting by ear, by smell, by patience.
